name: page-nav
title: Page Navigation
description: Move between the pages of an app: grouped pages with badges and sub-pages, current page marked and its group opened, a filter for long lists, collapse to icons, and any router via renderLink.

meta.intent: Move between the pages of an app and always know where you are.
meta.origin: Designed from intent on the stock shadcn sidebar

docs: Render PageNav inside SidebarProvider, next to SidebarInset. Pass currentPath and renderLink from your router.
